craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at incomparability. Device: end-dash→comma (peerlessness stated softly, nook questioned). Rejected: 'match/equal' for peer — killed: pratinidhi is stand-in; peer kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Past quality, whose self is sheer eminence averred,
Bhava, in what nook lurks thy peer?
l4.sanskrit_cite: guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava

reads_against.argmap: Of beyond-guṇas, whose self is utter excellence.; In which part, O Bhava, is a substitute of yours found? → No part holds a substitute for you beyond guṇas.
c1_essence: No substitute past strands; nondual self yet cheating glamour; wish-tree sprouts powers, lordship, ending.
reads_against.l2: You stand past the strands, yourself proclaimed sheer wonder — in what corner, Bhava, could a second you be found?
l3: Past quality, whose self is sheer eminence averred —

reads_against.t1: Of you beyond guṇas, whose self is described as utter excellence — in which part, O Bhava, is a substitute for you found?
